description: This file defines the EmployeeLanguageDao class, which manages database operations related to employee languages in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, deleting, and searching employee language records, utilizing Doctrine ORM for query building and pagination.

classes.name: EmployeeLanguageDao
classes.description: Data access object class for handling CRUD and search operations related to employee languages within the OrangeHRM system, extending the base data access class.

methods.name: saveEmployeeLanguage
methods.description: Persists an EmployeeLanguage entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: getEmployeeLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves a specific EmployeeLanguage record based on employee number, language ID, and fluency ID.

methods.name: getExistingEmployeeLanguageRecordsForEmpNumber
methods.description: Checks for existing language records for an employee, given a list of entries.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeLanguages
methods.description: Deletes specified language records for an employee.

methods.name: getEmployeeLanguages
methods.description: Retrieves a list of employee language records based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getEmployeeLanguagesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employee language records that match search filter parameters.

methods.name: getAllowedEmployeeLanguages
methods.description: Retrieves allowed languages for an employee, based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getAllowedEmployeeLanguagesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of allowed languages for an employee.

methods.name: getEmployeeLanguagesPaginator
methods.description: Creates and returns a paginator object for employee language search results, applying filters and sorting.

methods.name: getAllowedEmployeeLanguagesPaginator
methods.description: Creates and returns a paginator object for allowed employee languages, including join and filter logic.
